title: Minimal-denominator conjecture for relative extremal projectors
statement:
Let ${\mathfrak g}$ be a reductive Lie algebra, ${\mathfrak l}$ a Levi subalgebra, and $P({\mathfrak g},{\mathfrak l})$ the relative extremal projector. Let

$$
D({\mathfrak g},{\mathfrak l}):= \prod_{i=1}^\infty \mathop{\rm HC}\nolimits_{\mathfrak l}^{-1}\biggl(\prod_{\alpha\in\Delta({\mathfrak u}^+)}(H_\alpha+i)^{\rho_{\mathfrak g}}\biggr)
$$

be the lower-bound denominator from the preceding proposition. **Minimal-denominator conjecture.** There is a formula for $P({\mathfrak g},{\mathfrak l})$ with total denominator $D({\mathfrak g},{\mathfrak l})$. The conjecture asserts that the lower bound for the total denominator is achievable, giving a formula with the smallest denominator predicted by the proposition.
source_name: Charles H. Conley and Mark R. Sepanski, “Factorizations of relative extremal projectors”, arXiv:1507.02587 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.02587

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2015).
